decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.&nbsp; Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family:&quot;Tahoma&quot;,sans-serif">The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, in the designated refuse storage area, as shown on the approved drawing.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</span></p>

<p><span style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt;">The development of any buildings hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface water have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. Once approved, the details shall be implemented in full in accordance with the approved details and maintained as such.</span></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall not commence until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:</p><p>a: the extension / building(s)</p><p>b: hard surfacing details</p><p>c: boundary treatments including any gates</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained as such.</p>

<p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of&nbsp;landscape works which shall include:</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">- Planting plans (at a scale not less than 1:100)</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">- Schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of planting) and proposed numbers / densities</p><p style="padding:.75pt .75pt .75pt .75pt">- Written specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken.</p>
description: Single and two storey side to rear extension to provide new attached dwellinghouse; single storey rear extension; landscaping; separate amenity space (Demolition of detached garage)
